title: Harden LibraryProfiles save review authority
summary: Add backend-owned settings save review entries and use them in the WebView save dialog so normalized/mirrored LibraryProfiles changes display accurate redacted current/new values. Preserve custom LibraryProfiles IDs when only the display name changes and surface post-save refresh failures.
reason: LibraryProfiles save had multiple trust gaps: the WebView review table inferred values from the raw patch instead of backend-normalized data, custom profile names could silently change backend IDs, and save success could hide refresh failures that left stale settings on screen.
behavior_before: Save review rows were rendered from raw submitted changes, mirrored keys such as SourceMovies could show incorrect or missing new values, sensitive raw values could appear in the modal, custom profile names could rewrite IDs, and post-save refresh errors were swallowed.
behavior_after: Backend preview/save responses include redacted review_entries for actual changed/removed keys; the WebView review and overwrite summary use those entries, custom LibraryProfiles IDs remain stable across display-name edits, and refresh failures are surfaced in Settings and Libraries status.
